_source: findings/26_dcs_splitz_governor_shield.md:934-1102 (proto/charge_collections/pricing/v1/pricing_api.proto:14-49, payouts/pkg/ccSdk/config.go:22-29). Governor is a rule-SELECTION engine (bool Evaluation + Score per rule, no fee numbers); Charge Collections' Rule message is the actual fee schema. Amounts are in paisa (Razorpay convention) throughout, matching payouts.fees/payouts.tax (both `int unsigned`) and payouts.amount (`bigint unsigned`) column units in payouts/internal/database/migrations/20200615182810_create_payouts_table.go.
_task_requirement: Task specifies: flat fee Rs 2 + 18% GST for IMPS; free_payout counter 0. Rs 2 = 200 paisa; 18% of 200 = 36 paisa tax. This is an explicit arena requirement, independent of the SDK mock's own built-in default (fee=500,tax=90 for method=fund_transfer&&mode=IMPS, findings/26:1069) -- documented here as a deliberate deviation for reproducible golden-flow assertions.

special_case_overrides._note: Mirrors the real ccSdk mock's own override precedence (findings/26:1067-1071) so tests exercising these paths behave consistently: purpose==rzp_fees/refund => fee=0,tax=0; fee_type==free_payout => fee=0,tax=0.

free_payout_counters._source: payouts `counters` table (internal/database/migrations/20220526144631_create_counters_table.go): id, balance_id, free_payouts_consumed_last_reset_at, free_payouts_consumed (default 0), account_type, created_at, updated_at.
free_payout_counters._note: Seeded via payouts.sql counters INSERT, one row per merchant balance_id, free_payouts_consumed=0 at reset.
